cases.question: ¿Cuánto se compró a cada proveedor en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total_compras FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi JOIN public.supplier AS s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.business_name LIMIT 50
